import unittest
from raft.state import RaftNode

class TestRaft(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_raft(self):
        n = RaftNode('n1')
        n.current_term = 3
        ok, t = n.handle_append_entries(term=1, leader_commit=0)
        self.assertFalse(ok)
        ok2, t2 = n.handle_append_entries(term=4, leader_commit=2)
        self.assertTrue(ok2)
        self.assertEqual(n.log.commit_index, 2)

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
